classification: CALCULATED quasi-static partial-geometry brackets; NOT S11 measurement/3D EM qualification
reference_planes: U70 terminal21 carrier solder-land centre -> J7 signal solder-land centre. Series-L/shunt-C sensitivities represent unresolved castellation/U.FL-to-cable transitions; physical cable reference planes require calibration.
limitations: No guaranteed material-er/solder-mask RF bounds from standard order; ranges are engineering sensitivities

HASL roughness and mask modeled by explicit allowances, not measured
